description: This file provides functions for creating, reading, and checking symbolic links (reparse points) on Windows using ctypes to interface with Windows API functions.

classes.name: GenericReparseBuffer
classes.description: Represents a generic reparse buffer structure for Windows API.

classes.name: SymbolicLinkReparseBuffer
classes.description: Represents a symbolic link reparse buffer with properties to access link details.

classes.name: MountPointReparseBuffer
classes.description: Represents a mount point reparse buffer with properties to access link details.

classes.name: ReparseDataBuffer
classes.description: Union structure encapsulating different reparse buffer types for Windows API.

methods.name: _ToUnicode
methods.description: Converts a byte string to a Unicode string, handling attribute errors.

methods.name: _GetKernel32Dll
methods.description: Loads and caches the kernel32 DLL for Windows API calls.

methods.name: FastCreateReparseLink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link (reparse point) from a source folder to a link folder.

methods.name: FastIsReparseLink
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a reparse point (symbolic link).

methods.name: FastReadReparseLink
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link or mount point reparse point.
